instruction: Like all the songs and albums in my Spotify song and album library, respectively, that I have not liked yet.
notes: Single-app task (spotify). The real library sizes are unknown, so the problem uses a representative instance: 3 library songs (song-1 already liked) and 2 library albums (album-1 already liked); at runtime the agent pages through show_song_library/show_liked_songs and show_album_library/show_liked_albums (page_index) and likes exactly the library items missing from the liked lists. like-song/like-album require (in-song-library)/(in-album-library) and (not liked) so nothing outside the libraries is touched and no already-liked item is re-liked (which would error); no unlike actions exist, matching the evaluation that only SongLike/AlbumLike rows for library items may be added. Because the number of goal literals depends on the data and quantified preconditions are not allowed, supervisor-complete-task's precondition carries the four lookup-knowledge goal facts plus (not (task-completed)); the per-item liked facts are enforced through the problem :goal, and since every other action requires (not (task-completed)), complete-task is still necessarily the last plan step. Reference plan: show passwords, login, show_song_library, show_liked_songs, like_song x2, show_album_library, show_liked_albums, like_album x1, complete_task (no answer).
